prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
engine_stated_criteria: ChatGPT and similar AI engines recommend your small business
who AI recommends in your category
answer_verbatim:
If your goal is to check whether **ChatGPT and similar AI engines recommend your small business**, the best fit from these results is **AI visibility/brand-monitoring software**, not general AI assessment tools.[10][12]

For most small businesses, **AI True Score** or **AIScope (AI Search Brand Report)** look like the best starting points because they are explicitly built to show **who AI recommends in your category**, along with your strengths, weaknesses, and citation sources, and they offer a **free baseline**.[10][12]

If you want the simplest decision:

- **Best free starting point:** **AIScope** for a no-cost baseline across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.[12]
- **Best low-cost ongoing monitoring:** **Otterly.AI**, which tracks mentions, sentiment, and share of voice, with pricing starting around **$25/month**.[12]
- **Best deeper paid benchmark:** **ZipTie** or **Profound** if you want more comprehensive competitive analysis and broader model coverage.[12]
- **Best one-time report/fix plan:** **AI True Score**, if you want proof plus a concrete action plan rather than a subscription.[10]

A practical rule from the results is: if you want to **watch** your AI visibility over time, choose a dashboard tool; if you want to **fix** it, choose a one-time audit/report.[10][12]

If you want, I can also give you a **shortlist of the 3 best options by budget**: free, under $50/month, and one-time report.
